@Nadia Fennimore: Gideon's post in this channel says both Hartford gate lanes were working as of **11:07 AM on 3 Aug**. He posted that at 11:08 AM and wrote "as of Aug 3, 11:07."

The first check-in after kiosk 1 came back was **trailer 8836**. Mateo Quiroga posted at 11:03 AM that the kiosk was back and the guard had checked in that trailer, and dispatch could see it. This comes only from the channel history, so if the write-up needs the full gate log, Gideon or Mateo would be the ones to confirm it.
